title: Kiyim va tashqi ko'rinishni tasvirlash
why: Aeroportda kutib olish, olomonda odam ko'rsatish, do'konda kiyim tanlash — hammasida bir qolip ishlaydi: wear fe'li Present Continuous da.

points.text: Ayni damda kiyilgan kiyim haqida wear fe'li Continuous da ishlatiladi: She is wearing a red dress. Bu «hozir egnida» degani.

examples.en: She is wearing a blue coat.
The man in the black jacket is my brother.

points.text: Doimiy odat haqida bo'lsa, Simple ishlatiladi: He always wears a suit at work. Farq o'sha — hozir yoki har doim.

examples.en: He always wears a suit to work.

points.text: Ba'zi kiyimlar ingliz tilida doim ko'plikda: trousers, jeans, shorts, glasses. Ular «a» olmaydi va are bilan keladi. Bittasini aytish uchun a pair of ishlatiladi.

examples.en: I need a pair of shoes.

points.text: Kiyim tasvirida sifat tartibi ishlaydi: o'lcham → rang → tur. A long black coat. Naqsh uchun striped, checked, plain ishlatiladi.

examples.en: She's wearing a long black coat.
He's got a striped shirt on.

common_errors.wrong: She wears a red dress now.
common_errors.right: She is wearing a red dress now.
I have new trousers. / I have a new pair of trousers.

common_errors.wrong: She is wearing a black long coat.
common_errors.right: She is wearing a long black coat.
common_errors.why: Sifat tartibi: o'lcham rangdan oldin turadi.
Dress — kiyintirmoq jarayoni. Egnida bo'lgan kiyim uchun wear ishlatiladi.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md dagi shkala.

items.focus: birlik yoki ko'plik kiyim nomini aniqlash
«a trouser», «jeans is», sifat tartibi xatolarini topish
o'zbekchadan tarjima: «U uzun qora palto kiygan», «Jinsim yangi»

final.task: Do'stingizni aeroportda kutib olishadi. Bugun nima kiyganingizni batafsil yozing, toki sizni topa olishsin. 5 gap.

skill_task.task: Odam olomondagi kishini kiyimiga qarab tasvirlaydi. Kiyimlar va ranglarni yozing.
